name: Forest
desc: A sunlit woodland clearing where nature reclaims what was once civilized. Wild grass grows untamed between a weathered camp tent and a striped merchant stall, with towering pine trees and mossy boulders standing silent watch.

name: ruins
desc: A haunted marshland shrouded in deep blue darkness, scattered with glowing mushrooms and eerie floating lights. The crumbled remnants of stone walls form an arena where something ancient — and dangerous — still stirs in the shadows.

name: temple
desc: An ancient temple frozen in eternal night, its cracked stone floors etched with glowing runes. Twisted vines crawl between collapsed pillars, and bioluminescent orbs cast a cold teal light across the ruins of a forgotten altar.
